name: Lucidchart
label: Lucid REST API
description: Lucid REST API via OfficialApiNode (nodes/lucidchart/api_spec.json). Official Lucid REST. Lucid-Api-Version is required; OfficialApiNode cannot set extra headers, so the documented path workaround is used (baseUrl https://api.lucid.co/v1). Partner program for marketplace. FedRAMP uses a different published base URL — override is not in OfficialApiNode; document the commercial host here. Official docs: https://developer.lucid.co/reference/headers. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data} or {error}. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Lucidchart official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"document_create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'document_create', 'document_get', 'document_search', 'document_trash', 'folder_list', 'collaborator_add', 'collaborator_remove', 'embed_get'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'document_create'.

schema.label: product
schema.description: document_create product. EXACT: lucidchart | lucidscale | lucidspark.

schema.label: role
schema.description: Collaborator role. Typical: owner | editor | commenter | viewer.

schema.label: Keywords
schema.description: Search keywords for document_search (POST /documents/search JSON body array). Example: ["architecture"].

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: document_create, document_get, document_search, document_trash, folder_list, collaborator_add, collaborator_remove, embed_get. Default: document_create. Example: document_create.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey access_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Keywords
configurationParameters.description: Search keywords for document_search (POST /documents/search JSON body array). Example: ["architecture"].

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.
